The energy spectrum of radiation is obtained by means of practical measurement by spectrometer and simulation by EGSnrc monte carlo method. The practical measurement of spectrometer and the simulation of EGSnrc monte carlo method have their own limitations. Through the analysis of experimental results, the energy spectrum below 10keV can only be measured by the spectrometer, because the minimum energy of EGSnrc is 10keV. The energy spectrum of EGSnrc simulation is in good agreement with the recommended value. The energy spectrum measured by the spectrometer will measure the scattering and characteristic peaks to some extent. So we should pay attention to the influence of characteristic peak and scattering on energy spectrum.

articleTitle: A two-stage method for constructing real-time high-precision temperature map
publicationTitle: 2019 14th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Temperature monitoring has many real-life applications in the fields of electricity, meteorology, manufacturing, agriculture, security, etc. Therefore, it is important to efficiently construct a high-precision temperature map based on a number of sampling temperature data collected by temperature sensors. For this problem, the traditional methods include the average value method, the finite element method, and the Kriging method, among which the Kriging method has the highest accuracy, but requires the highest complexity, preventing its applications in large-scale scenes. To overcome this drawback, a two-stage constructing method is developed, which divides all the pixels into two classes, called 1-level pixels and 2-level pixels respectively. For the 1-level pixels, it still uses the Kriging method to estimate the corresponding temperatures (to ensure accuracy). Based on estimated temperatures of the 1-level pixels, for the 2-level pixels it uses a local weighted mean method with low complexity to estimate the corresponding temperatures (to improve efficiency). Experimental results show that, the new method could greatly improve the efficiency of calculation, only with very few loss of accuracy, thus satisfying the real-time requirement in large-scale cases.

articleTitle: Study on aging characteristics of MOV in energy absorption branch of hybrid DC circuit breaker
publicationTitle: 2019 14th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: With the development of power electronics technology, the hybrid DC circuit breaker (HDCCB) consisting of mechanical switches, semiconductor devices and metal oxide varistor has been intensively studied. As an important component to protect HDCCB, the energy absorption of MOV is an important parameter affecting the development of DC grid protection. At present, the research on HDCCB mostly ignores the effectiveness of MOV protection performance. In this paper, we have carried out an accelerated aging experiment on the MOV in HDCCB's energy absorption branch, in order to explore the aging effect of the operating overcurrent wave generated by breaking short-circuit current on the MOV. The experiment results show that the operating overcurrent wave causes perforation damage to the MOV. Before the damage occurred, the MOV did not reach the aging standard. This study provides an experimental basis for the evaluation of MOV aging life in HDCCB.

articleTitle: A multi-channel multiplexer simulator for satellite on Zynq SoC
publicationTitle: 2019 14th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Modern satellite payloads are generating a large amount of data with very high data rates that brings great challenges to the test and simulation of the multi-channel multiplexer on satellite. Moreover, the development duration of satellite multiplexer is long, so the test of satellite data transmission might be delayed. To solve these problems, a multi-channel multiplexer simulator is designed and implemented on Zynq SoC. The simulator is in the form of standard 3U PXIe module integrating TLK2711, LVDS and RS422 interfaces. The simulator receives the multi-channel, high-speed and dynamic payload data and sends framed data through two downlink physical channels. In order to improve the efficiency of data multiplexing, the simulator receives payload data that assigns a virtual channel (VC) for every channel data on the programmable logic (PL). Then, the virtual channel schedule unit uses a virtual channel scheduling algorithm based on the Consultative Committee for Space Data Systems (CCSDS) Advanced Orbiting Systems (AOS) protocol on the processing system (PS). The 600Mbps high rate frame multiplexer of CCSDS AOS protocol is verified on Zynq SoC in the Closed Loop Testing System. And, the simulator has been applied to a certain satellite ground automatic testing system.

articleTitle: Research on UAV dynamic calibration system
publicationTitle: 2019 14th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: According to the the UAV's measuring and controlling characteristics, this paper proposes a design scheme for the UAV dynamic calibration system for use and maintenance requirements. Based on radar and radio communication technology, the calibration system simulates the electromagnetic environment under different conditions, fits the way of navigation trajectory by means of multi-point positioning. The calibration system includes three parts: electromagnetic environment simulating, radio signal measuring and calibration data processing. Utilizing the dynamic calibration system' the aircraft subsystem, the ground subsystem and the mission subsystem of the UAV are put under the overall measurement to verify the UAV parameters and technical status as a whole.

articleTitle: Shock wave overpressure testing system based on double external cavity fabry-perot interferometer
publicationTitle: 2019 14th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: By using Double external cavity Fabry-Perot interferometer..DEFPI..to measure the shock wave overpressure generated during the explosion, Combined with Ansys/LS-dyna nonlinear finite element analysis, Simulation analysis of pressure cloud map of blast wave propagation in air and the pressure schedule with different explosion. Design sensor layout and accurately measure shock wave overpressure signals at various locations in the explosion field. The solution overcomes the instant, multi-point, electromagnetic interference, long distance transmission of the explosion process, can improve the Confidence level of weapon system damage effect assessment.

articleTitle: Optical analysis of freeform spectacle lens based on eye model
publicationTitle: 2019 14th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Spectacle lenses performance is simulated based on the eye model system. The modulation transfer function (MTF) curve of spherical lens, aspheric lens and optimized lens is analyzed, and the results are compared and analyzed non-curved lenses were found to be more effective in improving image quality. For free-form lenses, we measured the far-field, progressive corridor and near-field in the simulated optical system, and studied the relationship between the face matching angle and the tilt of the endoscope and the MTF of the conventional spectacle lens and the free-form lens. The experimental results show that when the face fitting angle and the inclination of the endoscope inclination increase, the MTF decreases and the imaging quality deteriorates. The tilt of the endoscope has the greatest influence on the MTF value, followed by the face fitting angle, where the influence of the spatial frequency is negligible, but as the spatial frequency increases, the MTF also decreases. Therefore, for the free-form surface, when the face fitting angle and the inclination of the endoscope are different, the image quality is easily affected, so these two factors must be fully considered in the design.

articleTitle: An efficient waveform averaging method based on FPGA in oscilloscope
publicationTitle: 2019 14th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: In recent years, with the rapid development of the electronic information industry, the capture of high-speed signals has become a hot issue in the field of time domain testing. As a universal test instrument, oscilloscopes are widely used in various industries. In order to eliminate the noise superimposed on the input signal, the average capture mode is added to the digital oscilloscope. This mode averages the acquired multiple waveforms to make the waveform smoother. At present, the common practice needs to transmit the acquired waveform to the host computer, and the host computer performs the shift operation after the accumulation, so the average times can only be 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</sup>. This method requires more storage resources and the waveform refresh rate is low. For this reason, this paper proposes an efficient waveform averaging method based on FPGA. The method performs the arithmetic operation in the FPGA, so the average times is any integer from 2 to 65536, which improves the overall performance of the oscilloscope.

articleTitle: Measurement of air attenuation and recombination correction factors in synchrotron radiation X-rays
publicationTitle: 2019 14th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Absolute measurement of high fluence rate X-ray dose was required in thermonuclear fusion research and plasma diagnostic measurement. An ionization chamber used for the reproducibility of air-kerma in high fluence rate X-rays was designed, and the monoenergetic X-rays of (6-20) keV were absolutely measured on Beijing Synchrotron Radiation Facility. The air attenuation and recombination correction factors of the free-air ionization chamber were obtained experimentally. Thus, the air-kerma for the (6~20) keV monoenergetic X-rays can be determined.

articleTitle: Remote monitoring of power quality of high-voltage transmission lines
publicationTitle: 2019 14th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: The frequency, current, and phase of the transmission of high-voltage power lines are important measures of the quality of the power transmission. Therefore, it is very important to monitor the power transmission quality in real time. This thesis designs a portable non-contact online monitoring system for power quality of tramsmission lines. Using electromagnetic inductionprinciple to collect the induced current of AC high-voltage trasmission lines. The signal processing circuit converts the collected current signal into a stable voltage signal and displays the output. The current waverforms in the transmission lines can be monitored in real time. Experimental result show that the system can obtain current amplitude of instantaneous high-voltage transmission line, waveform quality, frequency fluctuations and other information.

articleTitle: A novel approach to measuring the source standing wave based on the multi-state technology
publicationTitle: 2019 14th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: The multi-state technology was proposed by Oldfield Etc.. It develops from 6-port technology. Its core idea is internal unity with multi-port technology, and what they have in common is to achieve the vector network parameter by using scalar information detection. The significant difference between them is that the space is replaced by time. Obviously, it can avoid the error which is produced by the reconnection, according to the multi-state instead of the multi-port. In addition to reducing the error, it simplifies the hardware devices. The complex algorithm can be implemented by programming in MATLAB. Thus, with the multi-state technology is applied to measure the source standing wave, not only it can reduce requirements for the hardware from the principles, but also solve a series of problems existing in the traditional method. Precise measurement of complex source equivalent reflection coefficient which results in the source standing wave is introduced using multi-state technology. By employing power meter and controllable multi-state two-port network, the complex source equivalent reflection coefficient with high precision can be obtained based on the theory of the power equation and two-port network transform relation. The experimental results have shown very good correlation with the theoretical prediction in the frequency from 8GHz to 12GHz. It proved that this method is correct and practical in engineering.

articleTitle: Design of arbitrary wave generator based on VXI bus
publicationTitle: 2019 14th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: This paper introduces an arbitrary wave generator based on VXI bus, which mainly includes the general frame, interface circuit, main function circuit design and main performance indicators. The arbitrary wave generator can produce high-quality sine wave, Square wave, triangular wave, slope function wave, negative slope function wave and arbitrary wave, and at the same time has the functions of amplitude modulation, frequency modulation, burst modulation, sweep frequency and so on. It can be widely used in the communication, radar and other electronic equipment testing and fault diagnosis.

articleTitle: Experimental study on rolling stabilization of sphere detector for subsea pipelines
publicationTitle: 2019 14th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Spherical detector (SD) is promising in the field of subsea pipeline defect detection because of low risk of blocking and being convenient to use. Rolling stability of the SD has a great influence on the detection quality. This paper proposes and experimentally demonstrates that the factors affecting SD rolling stability include the weight, size and mass distribution of the detector. SDs with different parameters equipped with a triaxial accelerometer are used to experimentally study these factors in a steel pipe containing air flow inside. The results show that heavier SD has stronger anti-interference ability; the SD size has little effect on the rolling stability; when the mass of the SD is concentrated on one plane, SD can roll steadily around a fixed axis; when the SD can rotate stably around one certain axis of the accelerometer, the vibration of the pipeline can be accurately detected by the acceleration component.

articleTitle: Development of Automatic Crimping System for Transmission Line
publicationTitle: 2019 14th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: There are many links in the construction process of transmission and transformation lines. The construction of wire crimping is a key link. The traditional wire crimping technology needs to manually move the wire during the crimping process. After the crimping, the size of the crimping wire and the distance of the wire moving are manually detected. The operation is cumbersome and the crimping and measuring dimensions are inaccurate. In this paper, an automatic crimping control system for the transmission line is designed with microcontroller as the main controller. The upper computer can manually set the moving distance of the wire and the movement of the wire. It can also show the diameter of the wire after crimping and the pressure at the time of crimping. The lower microcontroller automatically moves the wire according to the instruction of the upper computer, which also measures the three sets of hexagonal conductors against the margins and the pressure of the hydraulic pump output. What it's more, it can display the pressure and the margins on the serial port screen. Comparing with the traditional wire crimping system, the system saves manpower, improves work efficiency and reduces accident rate.

articleTitle: Double-level local SVDD based monitoring approach for batch processes
publicationTitle: 2019 14th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Conventional multiway support vector data description (MSVDD) may not function well for incipient fault detection of batch processes since it omits the deep mining of the local data information. To overcome this deficiency, this paper proposes a double-level local support vector data description (DLSVDD) based monitoring approach for batch processes. Two strategies including the multiblock modeling and the phase division are applied to mine the local information in views of variables and samples, respectively. Firstly, all process variables are divided into multiple local variables blocks according to the distance correlation coefficient between different variables. Then each sub-block is divided into multiple phases by spectral clustering of the training samples. Individual SVDD monitoring model is constructed for each phase of every sub-block. The results from all the individual SVDD models are ensembled by Bayesian inference. Case study of penicillin fermentation process shows the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Study on methods of suppressing signal truncation error in digital signal processing
publicationTitle: 2019 14th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: In the digital signal processing, it is necessary to perform conversion from high quantization precision to low quantization precision of the intermediate signals, i.e. the truncation of the data bit width, due to the calculation precision of some digital algorithms. The direct truncation of the high quantization precision signals will lead to a decline in the spurious-free dynamic range (SFDR) of the truncated low quantization precision signals. Truncation after adding the Dither to the high quantization precision signals could effectively reduce the harmonic distortion of direct truncation error and significantly improve the dynamic range of the low quantization precision signals. The simulation results of MATLAB show that truncation after adding the Dither could increase the SFDR of the low quantization precision signals by about 16dB.

articleTitle: A Hilbert transform and sine curve fitting-based method for estimating gain and phase errors in quadrature mixing structure
publicationTitle: 2019 14th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: To eliminate the influence of gain and phase imbalance between in-phase (I) and quadrature (Q) signals on receiver performance featuring the quadrature mixing, a method of estimating the imbalance parameters of I/Q signals is proposed based on the quadrature relation of I/Q channels in time domain. The method uses the output signal of channel I after Hilbert transform as the ideal reference signal to calculate the gain and phase error parameters of channel Q by sine curve fitting (SCF) and least square method (LSM). Experimental tests show that the proposed algorithm can estimate the I/Q imbalance parameters effectively and accurately.

articleTitle: A temperature-drift-free design for near-bit azimuthal resistivity tool
publicationTitle: 2019 14th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: This paper discusses the challenge of measuring signals for near-bit azimuthal resistivity tools. Current azimuthal resistivity tools present difficulties because of their length and complexity. These issues can be overcome by gathering azimuthal sensitive resistivity data near the bit. However, this still presents space difficulties. Single transmitters and receivers can simplify the structure, but encounter problems with temperature drift. Here, a design is proposed that uses a sensor structure with a single transceiver and two receivers. Real-time calibration and compensation for the analog circuits enables errors in the conditioning channels to be eliminated, with their temperature drift being suppressed across a wide range of temperatures. Experiments were undertaken to test the viability of the proposed measuring system and the results illustrate that its accuracy and reliability meet the requirements for improved azimuthal resistivity measurements.

articleTitle: Comparison of EGSnrc MC simulation of parallel-plate free air ionization chamber correction factors
publicationTitle: 2019 14th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: With the continuous development of Monte Carlo simulation, it provides greater convenience for the reproducibility of X-ray air kerma. The DOSXYZnrc package in the EGSnrc MC simulation program is used to modify the electron loss, scattering fluorescence and pupil edge penetration of the X-ray free air ionization chamber. Monte Carlo simulation is performed by two different approaches. The comparative analysis reveals the use of phase space files. The deviation between the correction factors obtained by the simulation and the correction factors simulated by the effective energy as the single-energy X-ray is substantially within 0.09%, and the deviations of only 70 kV and 240 kV are large, respectively 0.15% and 0.3%. The results show that the correction factors obtained by Monte Carlo simulation of effective energy as single-energy X-ray can also be used to correct the air kerma energy. It is more convenient and fast to simulate the correction factors through effective energy.

articleTitle: Agile satellite attitude optimal predictive control method based on Particle Swarm optimization
publicationTitle: 2019 14th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Agile satellite is a typical multi-body nonlinear system, and there is a strong coupling between the state variables and the input control variables. In order to ensure the control precision of agile satellite attitude, an optimal predictive control method based on Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO-NMPC) is proposed. The attitude position and the angular velocity at the next moment are obtained by establishing the discrete attitude prediction equation. Then the Particle Swarm Optimization algorithm is used to optimize the optimization objective function of the combination of the predicted attitude error and the predicted control moment, so as to obtain the equilibrium solution satisfying the attitude error and the optimal control moment, and realize the real-time prediction and rolling optimization control of the satellite attitude. By comparing and analyzing the simulation results with the sliding mode control method, it can be seen that the PSO-NMPC can achieve large-angle stable maneuver around 19s and the attitude stability precision can reach 7e-04" under the condition of sustained unknown disturbance torque. It shows good maneuvering efficiency and stability.

articleTitle: Application of a strain gauge cutting force sensor in machining process monitoring
publicationTitle: 2019 14th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Cutting force is a key factor that affects machining quality, it is closely related to cutting vibration, surface smoothness and etc. Measuring cutting force is an effective method for monitoring cutting condition and optimizing machining quality, but this needs a lot of experiments research to clarify the influence of cutting force on machining quality. Therefore, a self-developed strain gauge cutting force sensor is employed for cutting condition monitoring and machining quality analysis in this paper. Experiment results show that the cutting force sensor is able to measure dynamic cutting force reliably, and the measured cutting force can accurately reflect the changes of cutting parameter and cutting condition. Characteristic signals for reflecting machining quality and representing are also found in the cutting force data. The influence of cutting force on cutting vibration and surface smooth as well as cutting fault is preliminarily clarified. It proves that cutting force can be effectively used for monitoring cutting condition, optimizing cutting parameters and predicting cutting faults.

articleTitle: Quantum cascade laser driver in multiple trace gas monitoring
publicationTitle: 2019 14th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Real-time multiple trace gas monitoring instrument, based on photoacoustic spectroscopy has an important application in space capsule. The quantum cascade laser (QCL) is used in gas monitoring instrument. However, the requirement of short current pulse edge and high repetition frequency makes the design of the driver of QCL great challenge. The long current pulse edge makes QCL heat fast and widen its linewidth. On the other hand, low repetition frequency rate does not meet the requirements of gas measurement. In this work, we improve the capacitor charge-discharge pulse circuit and design a new pulse driver. The new pulse driver has short current pulse edge and high repetition frequency. Experimental results show that the driver outputs current with an amplitude greater than 1.7 amperes under a 12V DC power source and an equivalent resistor 2.73 omega; in addition, increase/decrease time is no more than 20 nanoseconds, a pulse width can be randomly adjusted, a smallest pulse width can be as low as 20 nanosecond, and a largest repetition frequency exceeds 1 MHz.

articleTitle: The fast time-interleaved ADC channel mismatch calibration method based on equivalent sampling and dynamic reference point
publicationTitle: 2019 14th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: This paper designs an efficient channel mismatch calibration method for TIADC (time-interleaved analog-to-digital converter) system, in order to reduce the complexity and inefficiency of the conventional correction methods. Based on the principle of equivalent sampling, the sampling data of a certain number of cycles is overlapped to one cycle high-resolution data, from which all parameters needed to correct channel mismatch, such as average value, amplitude range and phase, can be acquired, so the calibration of the offset mismatch, gain mismatch and time mismatch can be realized at the same time, avoiding the great calculation of FFT or curve fitting. By normalizing the three parameters, these channels can be turned into points in the three dimensional space, the point with smallest distance sum respected to all the other points can be chosen as the reference channel, the calibration time is reduced consequently. Simulation and application results show that the method can measure above-mentioned errors rightly and enhance the performance of TIADC efficiently, at the same time, reduces the complexity and calculation.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of the control unit for DIC measurement system
publicationTitle: 2019 14th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: In this paper, a recently designed in situ sensing system named Channelized Optical System (CHANOS) is introduced The main aim of the system is to assist the scientists do research on ocean acidification using high-resolution CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> concentration measurement instruments in sea water. The system can be used to measure total dissolved inorganic carbon (DIC) in the sea water. The marine carbonate system can be estimated under the help of the determination done by this compact single sensor. The system is based on modular design thought, and it can be employed to accommodate for DIC according to spectrophoto-metric detection of H<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup> concentrations. This paper reports the whole design of system electrical system structure, describes the power control circuit and reference lADClDAC design. In the process of laboratory testing, the control unit suggests that the circuit design in CHANOS system can run stable and also meet the requirements of the system.

articleTitle: Data modeling of calibration parameter measurement based on MLP model
publicationTitle: 2019 14th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: This paper discusses the combination of MLP model technology and data processing technology of calibration parameter measurement. Based on MLP model, this paper studies how to deal with measurement data modeling, diagnosis and verification of the model, and combines MLP model with calibration parameter measurement to solve the practical problem of signal measurement data processing. MLP model is used to model a large number of measured data of calibration parameters instead of traditional polynomial regression and least square method, which improves the accuracy and efficiency of data processing.

articleTitle: Study on Ultrasonic power response sensitivity of the PVDF pyroelectric sensor
publicationTitle: 2019 14th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: The previous studies have demonstrated that the PVDF pyroelectric sensor has good effects on acoustic power measurement. As a sensor, the accuracy of the measurement results is directly related to the performance of the sensor. One of the most important performance indicators is the sensitivity of the sensor. In this study, the ultrasonic power response sensitivity of the PVDF pyroelectric sensor was defined. To study the sensitivity of the sensor, the finite element method based on the physical model of the PVDF pyroelectric sensor was used to analyze the relationship between the amplitude of output pyroelectric voltage and the acoustic power. Besides that, a large size PVDF pyroelectric sensor was used for the detection of the different acoustic power. Finally, the measurement and simulation results were compared. It is found that the amplitude of output pyroelectric voltage is basically linear with the radiated acoustic power. According to the calculation, the theoretical value of the ultrasonic power response sensitivity is 0. 1606mV/W, the simulation value is 0.1608 mV/W, and the experimental value is 0.1414 mV/W. These three values are basically equal. The study shows that the ultrasonic power response sensitivity of the PVDF pyroelectric sensor is reasonable and feasible. It provides some help for the performance study of the PVDF pyroelectric sensor and indicates the potential to measure high-intensity acoustic power.

articleTitle: The advantage of magnetic gradient tensor measurement in deep boreholes
publicationTitle: 2019 14th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Deep borehole magnetic measurement provides additional dimensional information, compared with aeromagnetic survey and ground-based magnetic measurement. Borehole magnetic measurement mainly depends on determing the three components of the magnetic fields at present, which can be used to enhance oil recovery and find mineral. However, it is susceptible to the geomagnetic time variations, extremely sensitive to the azimuth error, and greatly affected by the magnetic shielding of steel casing pipes. The magnetic gradient tensor measurement can effectively suppress the effects of geomagnetic variations and is insensitive to the azimuth error. In this work, the magnetic shielding effect of a casing is simulated by COMSOL firstly, and the correctness of the simulations is verified by the experiments of placing the casing in the east-west and north-south directions respectively. Next, the magnetic field component B<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">z</inf> and the magnetic gradient tensor component B<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">zz</inf> on the casing axis are simulated by using a magnet as the anomalous source, and field experiments prove that the magnetic gradient tensor is relatively less affected by the magnetic shielding of the casing. Finally, through the simulations of ore bodies with different concentrations and grain sizes of magnetite, the advantage of magnetic gradient tensor measurement in deep boreholes is proved.

articleTitle: Research on the method of measuring the square wave voltage of oscilloscope calibrator based on digital voltmeter
publicationTitle: 2019 14th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: This text introduces a kind of method that testing the voltage of the oscilloscope calibrator square wave signal according to the common instrument including digital voltmeter. It doesn't need to purchase pulse voltmeter or develop a card and a test-software. It can make use of the resources which laboratory existing. The method can solve the problem that testing the voltage of the square wave signal of the oscilloscope calibrator by the high sample voltmeter like the 3458A.

Author Keywords: method based on voltmeter with high sample

articleTitle: Numerical simulation of ion thruster plume to spacecraft charging
publicationTitle: 2019 14th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Dense plume induced by electric propulsion thruster has a character for high density and low energy, they are quite different from space plasma on geosynchronous orbit. Moreover, charge-exchange ions (CEX) of ion plume the influenced by spacecraft surface potential may form backflow, which would impact the spacecraft surface and make spacecraft surface charging becoming more complicated. Therefore, the ion thruster plume model was established and a numerical simulation using particle-in-cell (PIC) method and Monte Carlo Collision (MCC) model was adopted to obtain CEX ions distribution by plasma simulation software SPIS. The self-consistent electric potential is obtained from neutrality hypothesis. Based on simulation results, the paper calculated the electron and ion charging current, secondary electron and backscattered electron emission current, and built the computation method of the surface charge potential by charge and discharge balance equation. The results suggested that the thruster plasma current mainly accounts reason for spacecraft surface charging when thruster is on work. Moreover, the backflow and neutralization electron current can decrease high surface potential caused by spacecraft charging.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation and characteristic comparison of sonic nozzle
publicationTitle: 2019 14th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: As the main standard flowmeter, Sonic nozzle has been widely used in aerospace, petrochemical and biomedical fields. Recently, a number of studies have been conducted on small-scale sonic nozzles. Since the standard ISO sonic nozzle is difficult to process at a small scale, the geometry of the shrink nozzle, the diffusion nozzle and the conical venturi nozzle is proposed based on the circular ISO nozzle, and the geometric structure and shape flow to the nozzle. A preliminary analysis of the effects of the characteristics was carried out. In this paper, the computational fluid dynamics method is used to numerically simulate the flow field inside the three sonic nozzles. The influence of the geometry of the constricted section, the throat and the diffusing section on the nozzle flow characteristics is analyzed and compared with the annular ISO nozzle. In contrast, the flow characteristics of four kinds of microsonic nozzles are compared. Considering the feasibility of actual processing, the geometric structure with better discharge coefficient and critical back pressure ratio is obtained, which provides a reference for the development of micro nozzles.

articleTitle: A novel post-processing technique for high resolution digital storage oscilloscope (DSO) based on cascade average
publicationTitle: 2019 14th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: High resolution digital storage oscilloscope (DSO) plays a significant role for electric equipment to keep systems safety, reliability, and availability. In the architecture of such an instrument, a key process is post-processing unit, which is optimizing the effective number of bit (ENOB) for some specific requirement. Tradition digital average method is popular for it is easy to implement. However, this technique has the problem of bad performance in transition band with Gibbs effect. In this work, we propose a new average method as high resolution strategy which cascades a number of stages of two-lap rectangle filter. Closed-form equations of resolution improvement and band limitation of this method have been explicitly derived. This method improves the bandwidth and is better than tradition average method in band performance. Experimental results based on baseline test and waveform test show that lower noise and better SNR using the proposed method.

articleTitle: ZYNQ-Based Embedded Test Equipment with Interface Protocol User-Configurable Method
publicationTitle: 2019 14th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Nowadays, embedded architecture is widely used in the design of test equipment. However, after the traditional embedded test system is completed, it cannot adapt well to the situation where the protocol content is changed. Especially in the industrial and military fields, the content of the interface protocol will often be modified. Therefore, this paper proposes an interface protocol user-configurable method, and uses this method to design a template of interface protocol table and an embedded test equipment based on ZYNQ. When the interface protocol changes, the user configures the interface protocol table according to the changed content, so that the system can dynamically adapt to the changes. This method guarantees a number of performance indicators, and improves the versatility and maintainability of the system.

articleTitle: Development of automatic verification device for zero error of new steel measuring tapes
publicationTitle: 2019 14th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Steel measuring tape is one of the most common tools used in modern length measurements. In the verification process, the zero error has a great influence on the full-scale error of the steel measuring tape. In this work, we propose a new type of steel measuring tape zero error automatic verification device based on the mechanical detector independently developed by our institute and the modern technique of CCD image acquisition. And the uncertainty is also evaluated This project is of great significance for improving the accuracy and efficiency of the steel measuring tape verification and better achieving the traceability of the steel measuring tape.

articleTitle: Design of an anti-interference lightning current acquisition module
publicationTitle: 2019 14th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: To improve the anti-interference performance of a lightning current acquisition device, a redundant signal conditioning channel is adopted, i.e., an additional signal acquisition channel is provided to acquire the lightning current signal, and a dual-channel ADC is applied to acquire the two lightning current signals induced by the same conductor simultaneously. Then, the acquired data are sent to a DSP for similarity matching. If the similarity reaches the set value, the two lightning current data are considered to be matched and the lightning current data are determined to be valid and then stored, otherwise discarded, waiting for the arrival of next data. In this way, the interference signals are eliminated with true lightning current signals being retained only while the lightning current characteristic parameters are acquired and the lightning current signal waveform is reproduced, thereby improving the accuracy of lightning current monitoring. Also, this saves valuable storage resources, improves the processing efficiency and ensures real-time monitoring.

articleTitle: Research on prediction method of roll shaft performance decline based on logical regression
publicationTitle: 2019 14th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: This paper takes flexible material R2R processing equipment as the research object, aiming at the problem of roll shaft performance degradation during the actual processing, proposes a roll shaft performance degradation prediction method based on logical regression, and evaluates the roll shaft performance status through the established model. The experimental results show that the root mean square value of the processing roll shaft is not more than 0.1 when it is in normal operation, and when the performance index value of the roll shaft is below 0.8, it indicates that the roll shaft is damaged and needs to be maintained in time.

articleTitle: Research on classified prognostic and health management scheme for key components of nuclear power plant
publicationTitle: 2019 14th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: The condition monitoring and management of nuclear power plant(NPP) components is an important link to ensure the safe operation and nuclear safety of nuclear power plant. In order to ensure the good technical performance of nuclear power components, maintenance measures, periodic safety inspection, risk assessment, fault tree analysis, aging management and other methods are used for the maintenance and condition assessment of nuclear power components. However, these methods can not fully and accurately grasp the technical status of the components. In order to fully and accurately grasp the technical status of components, this paper starts from component fault prognostic and health management(PHM), analyses the system and component composition of nuclear power plant, and puts forward the classified health management scheme of nuclear power plant components. Based on the analysis of the elements of fault prognostic and health management for nuclear power plant components, the basic framework of health management for nuclear power plant components fault prognostic and health management is proposed. Finally, taking the health management of steam generator(SG) as an example, the design of the health management framework of nuclear power plant components is explored. By means of component health management, the development and change of component performance can be predicted, and on this basis, corresponding measures can be taken to improve the comprehensiveness, initiative and accuracy of component management of nuclear power plant.

articleTitle: Research on interference suppression of permanent magnet brushless DC motor based on multi-order sliding mode
publicationTitle: 2019 14th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: This paper uses MATLAB/Simulink software to simulate the brushless DC motor drive system without rotating shaft sensor. In this paper, the commutation point signal is obtained by line-to-line back electromotive force. The speed and current are controlled by sliding mode controller. The three-phase inverter outputs voltage to the brushless DC motor. Finally, the speed, voltage, current and angular position of the brushless DC motor are obtained. The experimental results verify that the proposed control scheme can effectively suppress the transient load interference and enable the speed to recover the steady state value in a short time.

articleTitle: Design of fourth-order IIR digital filter based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2019 14th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: The IIR filter is a widely used digital signal processing component, which can be roughly classified into direct type, cascade type and parallel type. The IIR filter coefficients are designed by using MATLAB Buffer function, and implemented on the FPGA using Verilog language. The circuit is composed of several second-order filter cascades. When the sampling frequency is 44. 1KHz, the cut-off frequency of the passband is KHz, and a sine wave of 1KHz+3KHz is input. After different types of IIR filters, a KHz sine wave is output and passed. Visual graphical and hardware waveform results are simulated by MATLAB and Modelsim respectively.

articleTitle: Health index construction and remaining useful life prediction of rolling bearings
publicationTitle: 2019 14th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: The problems in the remaining useful life (RUL) prediction of rolling bearings are difficulty in determining the failure threshold and large prediction error with a single prediction model. To solve them, based on the adaptive boosting integrated relevance vector machine model (AdaBoost_RVM), a method for constructing health indices and predicting RUL is proposed. The experimental results show that the failure thresholds of all the different bearings are 1 using the proposed method, and compared with the single RVM model, it yields a bearing RUL prediction that has a smaller error and is closer to the true value.

articleTitle: Estimation of power cable radiation emission
publicationTitle: 2019 14th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: In this paper, based on the theory of transmission cable, a theoretical model of the power cable radiation emission is proposed. The distribution voltage of the outer surface of the shield is calculated by transfer impedance of the power cable which is obtained by the current-probe approach. The current distribution of the outer surface of the shield is calculated by the Green function, and the electromagnetic field of any observation point is calculated by the principle of mirroring. Thus, an estimate of cable radiation emission is realized in theory. The model is verified by CST simulation, and the results show that the two are highly consistent, and the effect of cable height on radiation emission is analyzed.

articleTitle: Measurement of particle size distribution in suspension based on artificial neural network
publicationTitle: 2019 14th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: This paper proposes a method for measuring the particle size distribution in suspension, which combined with artificial neural network and ultrasonic attenuation effect. The artificial neural network is used for active learning instead of the traditional inversion algorithm, which can effectively solves the problem that the traditional measurement method is too dependent on the selection of the inversion algorithm and the calculation of the theoretical model is large. Ultrasonic attenuation experiments were carried out on the suspension, using a focused ultrasonic measurement system to obtain an attenuation signal with the information of the particles in suspension. The eigenvalues are extracted from the denoised signal, and 15 eigenvalues such as rise time, peak time and attenuation coefficient are obtained, to form the input feature matrix of the neural network model. The sieving method was used as a control test to obtain a theoretical value of the particle size distribution, and also as a theoretical output matrix of the neural network model. In addition, three suspension samples with different distribution methods were used as test samples to evaluate the proposed method. The experimental results show that the results obtained by the neural network are in good agreement with the results obtained by the sieving method, the measurement efficiency is improved, and the measurement time is greatly reduced.

articleTitle: Development of integrative measurement system for ignition and optical performance of high-power xenon lamp
publicationTitle: 2019 14th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Aiming at the testing requirement of the light source of KM6 large solar simulator, a set of integrated measuring system for ignition and optical performance of high power short-arc xenon lamp is developed, which is used for function verification of xenon lamp trigger and power supply control system, measurement of optical performance parameters such as luminous efficiency, light distribution curve and optical efficiency of xenon lamp. Thus it provides reliable data support for the selection of light source, optical system design and operation of solar simulator.

articleTitle: Research on novel method of modulation generating controllable jitter
publicationTitle: 2019 14th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: In high-speed data links, the data rates continue to increase, and the rapid increase in the operating rate of digital systems will inevitably significantly reduce the jitter tolerance of digital systems. Jitter therefore has become a crucial obstacle to the stability and effective rate of high speed digital systems. Generating controllable frequency, amplitude and component of jitter plays an important role in jitter tolerance testing and would help designers to better specify analyze jitter. This design proposes a novel method of modulation to generate controllable jitter, bases on the principle of modulation and uses digital processing to achieve controllable jitter. This design uses the TIE measurement in MATLAB to verify that the amplitude, frequency and component of generated jitter is controllable. And then proposes a hardware implementation method. The whole hardware design is mainly divided into modulation signal digitization, waveform digitization, digital signal superposition, comparison, filtering and digital to analog conversion.

articleTitle: New design of differential metal detector for long distance metal detection
publicationTitle: 2019 14th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: This paper presents a new metal detector design structure based on the traditional pulse induction (PI) metal detector (MD). The new design is able to restrain interference to the receiving coil resulted from the magnetic field of the transmitter coil and the ambient noise. The new metal detector is composed of transmitter coil, compensation coil and differential receiver coil, with all modules arranged in the same plane. This paper determines the relationship between the whole structure and each module based on theoretic analysis, and assures the signal-to-noise ratio of the whole design by use of the constrained relationship between radius and number of windings of each module, and builds a new detector. Upon the experimental verification, it is found that the output voltage of the receiving coil is only a few microvolts when not approaching metal, which is 100 times lower than that of the traditional differential metal detector. The metal can be detected clearly based on changes of the output voltage when approaching metal. Therefore, the new design has the potential for the long distance metal detection.

articleTitle: Monitoring method and communication mechanism of navigational lights in shielding environment
publicationTitle: 2019 14th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Airport navigation lights are an important guarantee for flying at night and in complex weather conditions. The stability and reliability of the lighting system directly affect flight safety. However, due to the large number and the wide range of navigation lights, the manpower and material resources required for the inspection of the entire airport are huge, and the manual inspections are likely to cause problems such as missing investigations, mis-examinations, and statistical errors, which will directly affect the safety of the entire airport. At the same time, since the outer casing and the lamp holder of the navigation lights are made of metal, the wireless transmission capability of the monitoring device is required to be stronger. Therefore, the conventional monitoring method and the wireless communication method cannot meet the requirements of the navigational light monitoring system. The low-power wireless monitoring method and communication mechanism of navigational lights in the shielding environment can enable the battery-powered monitoring device to realize the long-term monitoring of the navigation light state in the shielding environment and upload the data to the cloud platform.

articleTitle: Application of matrix theory in design and calibration of spacecraft ground system
publicationTitle: 2019 14th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: The ground wire is very important for the stable and reliable of Spacecraft System. After summarizing the existing resistance analysis method of spacecraft system, the article proposes a feature matrix model used to represent the resistance properties of the ground system. The feasibility of the model has been proved from theoretical analysis and verified by experiments. This model has solved the problem of calculating the resistance value of the tributary of the spacecraft system effectively. It is valuable and convenient to design, calibration and fault diagnosis for Spacecraft Ground System.

articleTitle: Simulation analysis of marine diesel engine SCR system
publicationTitle: 2019 14th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: The selective catalytic reduction (SCR) method is an effective method for ship exhaust treatment, which has become a research hotspot in recent years. The CAD 3D model of the 4135Ca diesel engine SCR catalyst system is established in this paper. Based on the mathematical model, the injection process of urea aqueous solution and the mixing process of droplets and exhaust are simulated, and the distribution of velocity field, pressure field and exhaust temperature inside the catalyst is also analyzed. Then the ESC emission experiments of the diesel engine are carried out. The experimental results are in good agreement with the simulation results, which verified the correctness of the model used in the numerical simulation.

articleTitle: Research on algorithm of cross-section area of oil storage tank capacity based on point cloud data
publicationTitle: 2019 14th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: The accuracy of oil storage tank capacity measurement is directly related to the accuracy of oil trade handover. With the gradual application of 3D laser scanning technology in the measurement of oil storage tanks, in order to improve the accuracy of v capacity calculation of oil storage tanks based on a large number of point cloud data, a method of point cloud sorting and triangular section area calculation with area approximation is proposed. By selecting two types of storage tanks for test analysis, the maximum relative error of this method is less than 0.02% compared with the two methods, which is suitable for the calculation of storage tank capacity.

articleTitle: Study on a gradient structure acoustic metamaterial for underwater sound sensing enhancements
publicationTitle: 2019 14th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Exploitation in improving the performance of underwater acoustic detection is endless. Acoustic metamaterials (AMMs), which have been rapidly emerging in recent years, can improve underwater acoustic detection performance through extraordinary acoustic wave manipulation to adapt to the ever-increasing new demands and challenges of water acoustic detection, such as the growing sophisticated, long-range, and high efficiency. In this paper, a gradient subwavelength structure is proposed inspired by similar structure AMMs in air; Simulations and experiments are carried out to study its feasibility and basic mechanism in underwater application. This type of AMM can trap a specific frequency of acoustic waves at a particular location, while achieving the amplification of acoustic signals. This work opens up new prospects for the development of acoustic sensors based on metamaterials underwater.

articleTitle: Data transmission subsystem interface converter for satellite AIT
publicationTitle: 2019 14th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Data transmission subsystem interface converter is one of the key equipments in satellite Assembly, integration and test (AIT). To realize high-speed data transmission and communication protocol verification for data transmission subsystem in satellite AIT, an interface converter is designed. In the paper, a high efficiency data transmission path and fast data format conversion method are proposed to solve the problem on converting large amounts of data with different interface protocol types at the same time. Moreover, a multi-port communication method based on a lightweight TCP/IP protocol (LwIP) stack is built, and achieve data interaction between multiple network ports on the the same network segment. Finally, the self-validation test results indicate that the interface converter has high efficiency and accurate data interface conversion capability and good stability, and also shows good performance in the actual satellite AIT, which provides a reliable reference for data protocol verification during satellite AIT.

articleTitle: Spot size diagnosis of monochromatic X-ray optics system based on an algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 14th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: A monochromatic X-ray optics system has been developed in this study which would mainly been used to calibrate the satellite-borne detectors. The system consists of four parts, including the X-ray source, the collimating system, the monochromator, and X-ray detectors. In particular, an algorithm has been proposed to diagnose spot size of monochromatic X-ray optics system. As a comparison, two methods were adopted to diagnose the spot size. Experimental results shows that the method and algorithm to diagnose spot size is feasible. This work will be helpful to research on spot size diagnosis of X-ray optics system, and would contribute to the calibration on ground of satellites-borne detectors.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of fast detection system for ocean evaporation duct
publicationTitle: 2019 14th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: In order to study the occurrence regularity and detection method of ocean evaporation duct phenomena, and to evaluate the height and intensity parameters of the duct, a fast detection system for ocean evaporation duct is designed. The system consists of measuring buoy, receiving terminal and data processing software. Data acquisition of temperature, humidity and air pressure at different height is completed by the buoy based on ZigBee wireless networking technology. And they are transmitted to the receiving terminal by the communication radio inside the buoy body. After data quality control and calculation processing, the atmosphere modified refractive index profile is calculated by software, then the height and intensity parameters of evaporation duct can be obtained. The sea trial results show that the system can obtain the height and intensity parameters quickly in the case of evaporation duct appearance, and has the characteristics of high measurement efficiency, good practicability and stable operation.

Author Keywords: the atmosphere modified refractive index profile

articleTitle: Design and test of a high precision digital CO monitor
publicationTitle: 2019 14th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: CO is a kind of colorless and odorless toxic gas, which is a potential threat around people. It is of great significance to do a good job in monitoring CO leakage. We have designed and tested a high precision digital CO monitor based on STM32 single chip microcomputer and embedded system. The sensor module of this monitor consists of TGS5342 CO sensor made by FIGARO and BME280 temperature, humidity and pressure sensor made by BOSCH. The TGS5342 CO sensor has been calibrated at the factory, eliminating the process of calibrating as most monitors used to executed. The monitor is equipped with an OLED display screen, which can display real-time data of CO gas concentration and environmental temperature, humidity and pressure. This monitor makes full use of the rich interface resources of STM32 single chip microcomputer and communicates via CAN bus. As a result, the monitor can not only work independently, but also flexibly organize network online monitoring. Compared with most products in the market, the monitor has the advantages of high precision, low power consumption, long life, small size and strong anti-interference ability, which can be widely used in industrial and civil fields.

articleTitle: Preliminary calibration of the hard X-ray imager LaBr3 probe
publicationTitle: 2019 14th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: The main purpose of this paper is to calibrate the detection efficiency and energy linearity of a hard X-ray imager (HXI), one of the payloads on the ASO-S satellite. In this experiment, HPGe calibrated by radioactive source was used as the standard detector, and the experimental device used was a double crystal calibration device. The experimental method is to first measure the single energy peak of the corresponding energy point with a standard detector, and then use the HXI LaBr3 crystal detector probe to obtain the same single energy peak. It should be noted here that in order to eliminate the statistical fluctuations and other factors, we set the detection time of both detectors to 1000 seconds. Then, the dobule crystal parallelism is detuned (ie, non-parallel) to measure the unfiltered background and the electronic noise. Finally, the open source software Root is used to perform relatively clean single-energy X-ray beam data obtained after subtracting the background data of the beam.

articleTitle: Automatic lung field segmentation based on the U-net deep neural network
publicationTitle: 2019 14th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Obtaining the lung region by automatic segmentation is a necessary step in lung analysis, and accurate lung segmentation is also useful for doctors to determine treatment options. In this paper, fully automatic lung field segmentation based on the U-net deep neural network is proposed. The proposed method is trained on a data set consisting of 200 CT images and tested on remaining 65 CT images. The network architecture consists of an encoder path to extract high-level feature and a symmetric decoder path to recover the image information wanted. We combine binary cross entropy and soft dice loss function as loss function to ameliorate the precise of segmentation. The final results show that our proposed method produces a significant DSC of 0.972 compared to other lung segmentation algorithms.

articleTitle: Characterization of electromagnetic properties by simulations using the double-ridged cavity
publicationTitle: 2019 14th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Cavity method is widely used in microwave measurement of electromagnetic properties. In this research, a new double-ridged cavity method is proposed, which can enhance the operational frequency bandwidth. Based on the perturbation theory, the measurement equations required for permittivity and permeability extraction are developed. And for the accurate obtaining of electromagnetic properties, a calibration method is introduced to calibrate the shape factors. The proposed method is firstly simulated using the High Frequency Structure Simulator (HFSS) to demonstrate the linear relationship between the resonant parameters and the electromagnetic properties. Thereafter, a series of standard samples are tested by using the numerical simulation. Compared with the reference data, the calibration method can obviously improve the accuracy of electromagnetic parameters. Especially the error of the imaginary part in complex permeability is reduced front more than 60% to about 4%.

articleTitle: Nitrate sensor based on ultraviolet absorption spectrometry for seawater: design, comparison and application
publicationTitle: 2019 14th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Nitrate sensor based on ultraviolet absorption spectrometry has been developed for measurement of nitrate in seawater. Compared with the chemical laboratory analyses, no chemical regents are required when ultraviolet absorption spectrometry is applied. It is quicker, simpler and easier to perform in on-line measurement. In response to marine environment, the sensor has been designed with an electrical scraper which is used to automatically clean the optical windows before measurement and effectively reduce the influence of biofouling. The results of the comparison experiment for standard solution show that the nitrate sensor has a good performance in accuracy which the average relative error is lower than 10%, and the correlation of the nitrate sensor with laboratory method for seawater samples is higher than 0.9. The nitrate sensor has now been deployed in Bohai sea floor for long-term on-line monitoring, running stably and acquiring large quantities of nitrate data.

articleTitle: Ultraprecision circulating cooling water machine using bidirectional control of cooling and heating power
publicationTitle: 2019 14th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: A circulating cooling water machine using agile bidirectional cooling and heating power control method is developed to produce circulating cooling water of high temperature stability and good dynamic performance. Cooling module based on thermoelectric cooling and multilayer compact structure is proposed to achieve cooling power output resolution at sub-watt level and quick response. Heating module based on a compact solenoid-in-tube structure is proposed to achieve heating power output with sub-watt level resolution and quick response. Experiments indicate that temperature stability of ± 3 mK, regulating resolution of 5 mK and regulating time of 128 s corresponding to 1 K step of circulating cooling water temperature are achieved with the developed machine. Thus, the developed machine can satisfy the challenging requirements of precision manufacturing.

articleTitle: Development of test-bed controller for hybrid electric vehicle based on dual-motor load system
publicationTitle: 2019 14th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Test-bed is a powerful tool for powertrain integration and control strategy development of hybrid electric vehicle (HEV). This paper focuses on developing a test-bed controller, which includes seven work modes, among them N/α and RG/v is studied deeply. To expand the torque-speed range of one motor, dual-motor is adopted as the load system of the test-bed and its torque distribution algorithm was developed. Road load simulation (RLS) algorithm was developed to meet the test requirement of RG/v mode and penalty function was added to improve test accuracy. PCI extensions for instrumentation (PXI) developed by National Instruments was chosen as controller hardware and appropriate boards were selected according to the actual needs. Eventually, the developed controller was tested on the test-bed and test results showed that the controller could respond command accurately, and meet the steady testing and dynamic testing requirements well.

articleTitle: Design of environmental quality monitoring system based on self-powered wireless wensor network
publicationTitle: 2019 14th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: In order to accurately real time monitor the environmental quality for the specific area, and solve the problem of interruption of traditional wireless sensor network because the battery is not durable and can not be updated in time, we design a wireless environment quality monitoring system with self-powered multi-sensor. In this system, the network node is powered by solar photovoltaic panels, and the maximum power point tracking control algorithm is optimized and improved. It solves the problem of abnormal work of sensor nodes caused by not charging the battery in time, and realizes the unattended real-time monitoring of the environmental quality. Besides, data fusion of the multi-node sensor is performed by using the data fusion algorithm. The experimental results demonstrate that the test data of our designed system agree well with the environmental quality data released.

articleTitle: Measurement method for microwave device noise characteristics
publicationTitle: 2019 14th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Noise introduced by microwave device itself has negative influence on signal processing and system performance. Measurements of microwave device noise characteristics, including noise Figure and four noise parameters, are one of the key and most challenging work in radio frequency and microwave engineering. Several kinds of measurement methods have been proposed. Source pull method is a classical way to measure noise characteristics by varying source impedance (or admittance) of device under test (DUT). However, the choice of source impedance affects the measurement accuracy significantly. Unsuitable number (much more than four) and positions of source impedances will increase measurement time, make experiment process more complicated, and introduce more uncertainty factors. To avoid the problems mentioned above, in this paper, the tuner based iterative cold method with only four source impedances is presented to determine noise characteristics of microwave device. A series of experiments on packaged microwave amplifier are performed. Results of the noise figures calculated by measured noise parameters and those directly measured by noise Figure analyzer are compared at different frequencies and show a fair good agreement which verify the efficiency and accuracy of measurement method.

articleTitle: Design and analysis method of reliable firmware of LWD tool’s controller
publicationTitle: 2019 14th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: As an essential component of Logging While Drilling (LWD) tool, controller is responsible for logging flow control, instruction decoding, environmental parameter measurement and data storage. Firmware with high reliability has substantial significance to ensure reliable work of the controller. A design and analysis method of controller's firmware is proposed in this paper. On the basis of function analysis of the controller, a flexible firmware architecture using modularization technology is presented. On the other hand, an improved Failure Modes Effects and Criticality Analysis (FMECA) method is presented, which considers coupling degree in determining conditional probability to introduce severe results given a failure mode occurs. Engineers can optimize the strategy of design resource distribution after criticality analysis, which may further improve the reliability of the controller's firmware. The proposed design and analysis method of reliable firmware is applied to new type neutron LWD tool's controller, which has worked reliably in several offshore wells.

Author Keywords: Failure Modes Effects and Criticality Analysis (FMECA)

articleTitle: Life prediction of fan bearings for traction motors of EMU based on RecurDyn
publicationTitle: 2019 14th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: During the operation of the EMU, the traction motor generates a lot of heat. The traction motor fan was added to the bottom of the EMU to solve the heat dissipation problem of the traction motor. The bearing is one of the important parts of the traction motor fan, which is of great significance for the bearing life prediction. In this paper, the multi-body dynamics simulation analysis method was proposed. According to the actual working condition of the traction motor fan of the EMU, the mechanical model of the traction motor fan was established. The rigid-flexible multi-body dynamics simulation analysis of the traction motor fan bearing was completed by RecurDyn software. According to the results of dynamic simulation analysis, the fatigue life analysis module was used to predict the life of the finite element. The life prediction result was basically the same as the basic rated life of the bearing, indicating that the life prediction method was reasonable.

articleTitle: Research on dynamic strain testing technology based on flexible piezoelectric element
publicationTitle: 2019 14th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: This paper first studies the internal mechanism of strain measurement of flexible piezoelectric elements through theoretical analysis. Then, based on this, the flexible piezoelectric sensor is designed in form, and the error of the flexible piezoelectric sensor is compensated. Finally, the flexible piezoelectric sensor and the strain gauge were compared and tested, and a new test method suitable for the dynamic strain parameter test of flight test was obtained.

articleTitle: Research of fast sheet thickness measurement with EMAT
publicationTitle: 2019 14th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: To solve poor adaptability of traditional thickness measurement method in sheet thickness measurement, a fast sheet thickness measurement method combining electromagnetic acoustic resonance (EMAR) is proposed. Because of the inverter signal, the new method can get a relatively complete frequency spectrum with only one excitation. The difference of sine waves and square waves have been analyzed by simulation. In the end, an experiment has been made to measure aluminum plates whose thickness are 1mm, 2mm, 2.9mm, 5mm. Results show that the fast sheet thickness measurement method can measure the thickness of sheet efficiently and rapidly with an absolute error below 0.1mm.

articleTitle: Signal detection with quantization noise based on compressive sensing acquisition system
publicationTitle: 2019 14th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: To promote the efficient use of spectrum resources, cognitive radio (CR) has been proposed. Spectrum sensing is the core technology of CR. In spectrum sensing, idle frequency bands should be detected for secondary users. Signal detection in spectrum sensing is a recent active research topic. Conventional spectrum sensing methods are based on Nyquist sampling and have high hardware requirements, thus limiting the use of these methods. The proposed compression sampling theory can overcome the limitation of Nyquist sampling and can solve this problem. In high-speed sampling, the effect of quantization noise is becoming more significant. In this paper, we study the signal detection in compressed sampling under the influence of quantization noise. Since the quantization noise is related to the quantization bits, we derive the relationship between the quantization bits and the detection rate (P<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">D</sub>). We also consider the input noise and investigate its impact on signal detection. Due the amplification of input noise in compressive sampling process, in comparison to the quantization noise, the input noise exhibits more serious impact on detection performance.

articleTitle: AM0 space solar cell calibration method based on GEO satellite
publicationTitle: 2019 14th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: With the development of new multi-junction solar cells for spacecraft, the calibration and test system of which is much more complicated than the single-junction Si solar cells, and the ground-based calibration technique has met lots of difficulties, not only in theory but in practice. Space calibration, which is in the actual working state of the solar cells, becomes the best way to evaluate their performance. Beijing Orient Institute of Measurement and Test has developed an AM0 space solar cell calibration device based on GEO (geostationary earth orbit) satellite. The device consists of two solar cell panels outside the satellite cabin, a data acquisition instrument inside the satellite cabin and several cables through the cabin. It can measure the short circuit current (Isc), I-V characterization and temperature of 31 solar cells, including GaAs subcells, multi-junction GaAs solar cells and Si solar cell. The Maximum Permissible Error(MPE) of I<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">sc</sub>: ±0.2% (measuring point): the MPE of temperature: ±0.5 c. Using “ Lost Twins Calibration Method ” to obtain ground AM0 primary standard solar cells, The inconsistency of I<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">sc</sub> between space solar cell calibration samples and ground solar cell samples is less than 0.4%. This research has completed the development of the solar cell space calibration device based on GEO satellite. Laboratory calibration and satellite testing have been completed and it will be launched in the first half of 2020.

articleTitle: Metal particles velocity measurement based on a novel structure of differential capacitance sensor
publicationTitle: 2019 14th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: A novel triangular-shaped electrodes differential capacitance sensor (TEDCS) is designed for measuring the average velocity of metal particles within the small-diameter pipeline in this study. Firstly the axial sensitivity distribution of the TEDCS is analyzed by finite element method. Then the spatial filtering effect of the TEDCS for velocity measurement is investigated. Results indicate that the velocity of the metal particles can be obtained by determining the equivalent peak frequency of the differential output signals of the TEDCS. Finally a TEDCS-based metal particles velocity measurement system is further developed and the experimental test results on a gravity-fed particle flow experimental apparatus are presented.
