Theoretical and experimental results demonstrate that the measurement method has a good repeatability, and the repeatability errors of the measured velocity are less than 8% over the velocity range of 2.44 $\sim$ 5.34 m/s.

articleTitle: High precision impedance measurement based on gigabit transceiver
publicationTitle: 2019 14th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: In this study, impedance measurement is implemented using the vector current-voltage method. The zero-crossing method is used to separate the real and the imaginary parts of the impedance vector, and the phase difference information is acquired using the high-speed data acquisition method. However, the limitation of the resolution of the phase difference often prevents the improvement of the accuracy of the impedance measurement. Therefore, in this paper, we propose a method for high-resolution phase measurement based on high-speed acquisition technology. Using the gigabit transceiver integrated in the XILINX K-7 Series field-programmable gate arrays, we achieve a sampling rate of 6 Gbps or higher, thereby improving the resolution of the phase difference time and considerably improving the accuracy of the impedance measurement.

articleTitle: A temperature-drift-free design for tri-component array induction logging tool
publicationTitle: 2019 14th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: A design of measuring system with zero temperature drift is proposed for the tri-component array induction tool. The designed down-hole system is able to survive high temperature up to 175°C. It deploys multiplexers before pre-amplifiers to switch 20 signals, including zero signals, calibration signals, and coil signals. A DSP chip and a FPGA chip are integrated for digital signal processing. An algorithm of digital phase sensitive detection is employed for calculating the amplitudes and phases of these three kinds of signals. In order to perform zero-temperature-drift measurements, real time calibrations are applied to the four analog conditioning channels, and the common-mode interference signals of the receiving coils are cancelled during the processing. Experimental data illustrate that, this high temperature system survives in the process of heating without obvious temperature drift.

articleTitle: Non-intrusive acoustic detection method for pipeline leak of hazardous substances
publicationTitle: 2019 14th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: For pipeline leak detection, the intrusive method will not only destroy the integrity of a pipeline but also cause accidents due to hidden dangers such as weld quality. Therefore, in this paper, a non-intrusive acoustic leak detection method based on wireless sensor networks is proposed. Firstly, a non-intrusive acoustic detection device is designed, which is easy to install and adjust. Secondly, the simultaneous signal sampling of each wireless sensor node is realized by the time synchronization method combining software and hardware. Finally, based on support vector data description (SVDD), a pipeline leak diagnosis model is established with the input feature vector consisting of peak coefficients, kurtosis and wavelet packet energy fraction of acoustic signals. According to the test result, the proposed method has high sensitivity, accurate leak diagnosis, precise location and low false/missing alarm rate. It provides a novel and effective technical means for the pipeline leak detection of hazardous substances.

articleTitle: Estimation and compensation of I/Q linear phase imbalance based on the generalized cross correlation and cross-power spectrum phase method
publicationTitle: 2019 14th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: The in-phase/quadrature (I/Q) imbalance results in insufficient mirror frequency attenuation, which must be enhanced using additional analog or digital signal processing. This paper proposes a novel method to solve the estimation of I/Q linear phase imbalance (LPI), which is the main part of the I/Q imbalance. LPI consists of time delay deviation (TDD) and local oscillator (LO) phase offset. Generalized Cross Correlation (GCC) and Cross-power Spectrum Phase (CSP) are commonly used methodologies of TDD calculation. Compared with other conventional methods of applying GCC or CSP alone, the proposed approach combines GCC and CSP to joint estimate LPI without additional hardware, where GCC is utilized to evaluate TDD and CSP is applied to estimate the LO phase offset with the TDD estimation value from GCC. The MATLAB simulation is utilized to evaluate the effectiveness of the proposed method. The experimental results of the complete suppression of the mirror frequency and the correct constellation show that LPI has been accurately estimated and compensated with the appropriate compensation structure.

articleTitle: Methods and research on detection of transmittance of muzzle smoke
publicationTitle: 2019 14th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: -There will be great number of settleable residues during shooting of firearms. In traditional smoke chamber-detection, taking smoke chambers before and after shooting as the data test environment may affect the detection result. Considering this, we propose to measure data in a smoke-free environment created by automatically discharging smoke in detection system after analyzing the impact of settable residues on detection results, which may effectively avoid such impact. Results of detection of transmittance of muzzle smokes of 5.8mm and 7.62mm ordinary guns indicate that average efficiency of transmittance of improved detection method is improved by 3.04% and 3.09%, standard deviation decreased by 0.0117 and 0.0079 respectively compared with traditional detection method, with improved reliability, reduced detection time and significantly enhanced detection efficiency.

articleTitle: Incremental fault diagnosis method for space on-orbit equipment
publicationTitle: 2019 14th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Prognostics and systems health management (PHM) have been manifested the pivotal role for guaranteeing the on-orbit service capacity of space equipment with high reliability, high security and maintainability. Considering the limitation of spatial information bandwidth and initial information, few shot learning based incremental fault diagnosis provides a new way for on-line fault detection of on-orbit equipment. In this paper, an incremental fault diagnosis method for on-orbit equipment based on cut edge weight estimation is proposed by combining the framework of collaborative learning and the idea of graph theory data editing. The experiment of applying above method to space actuating system was also carried out.

articleTitle: Cycle slip detection and estimation for ground-based high-precision local positioning system
publicationTitle: 2019 14th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Global Navigation Satellite Systems (GNSSs) have become an almost indispensable part of our infrastructure and modern life, but in a specific environment have its limitations, or cannot be applied. Pseudollites are ground-based transmitters that can provide similar navigation measurements as GNSSs. GH-LPS developed by NUDTis a new pseudolite system allows centimeter-accuracy single-point positioning for a mobile or static device. Carrier phase observations are commonly used in high-precision positioning applications, due to their millimeter precisions. Any cycle slip, if remained undetected, would deteriorate the high accuracy positioning. Hence, it is crucial to handle the cycle slips in the carrier phase measurements for GH-LPS. Carrier phase-based RAIM (CRAIM) algorithm is proposed to detect and estimate small cycle slips. In order to evaluate the performance, a kinematic test was conducted. The experiment demonstrated that the CRAIM method can be used to solve the problem of small (e.g. 1 cycle) cycle slips and GH-LPS can provide single point positioning with centimeter-level accuracy and sub-centimeter level precision.

articleTitle: Key comparison BIPM.RI(I)-K7 of the air-kerma standards of the NMIJ, Japan and the NIM in mammography x-rays
publicationTitle: 2019 14th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: The National Institute of Metrology, China(NIM) and the National Metrology Institute of Japan (NMIJ) conducted an international comparison of air kerma in the range of 25-35 KV of mammography. The measurement comparison uses an indirect comparison method. The National Institute of Metrology, as the leading laboratory, uses the molybdenum target reference free air ionization chamber to perform absolute measurement of (25~35) KV X-ray air kerma, and then under the same conditions. Pass the ionization chamber for calibration and give the scale factor. The ionization chamber is then calibrated in the radiation field of the other laboratory. The transfer ionization chamber was measured using a flat ionization chamber RC6M10167 from December 2018 to January 2018 under BIPM reference conditions. The deviation of the comparison results is between 0.3% and 0.4%.

articleTitle: Eye contrast sensitivity measurement system based on optical modulation method
publicationTitle: 2019 14th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Contrast sensitivity is an important parameter to evaluate visual characteristic of human eye, which is of great significance to clinical ophthalmology, image technology, environmental lighting, and optical detection, etc. According to the definition of contrast sensitivity, a method of producing test targets for human eye contrast sensitivity test is proposed with three-integrating spheres and special light modulators. By designing both software and hardware, an automated measurement system is built and human eye contrast sensitivity is measured by psychophysical experiment with cross ladder method. The characteristic of the system is the large contrast adjustment range and effective traceability of output parameters. Spatial frequency covers 0.8cpd $\sim18.0$ cpd. It meets the requirement of eye contrast sensitivity test very well. The research not only provides technical support for future large sample contrast sensitivity test, but also lays foundation for simulating human visual transfer model and establishing contrast sensitivity database for Chinese population.

articleTitle: A. GMM-Based intrusion detection for perimeter security system
publicationTitle: 2019 14th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: As the exploitation of shale gas has increased in recent years, the safety of perimeter protection for shale gas wells has become increasingly important. Today, there are a number of problems with algorithms that build models based on foreground signals for intrusion detection. The biggest problem is that the use of foreground modeling requires a large number of intrusion signals, but often in the actual environment, the intrusion signal is relatively small, the signal will be in a normal state without interference for a long time, and the signal waveform generated by different intrusion methods is also different. This can result in low intrusion detection rates and scattered models. Therefore, in this paper, based on the background modeling method, the perimeter detection of wellsite intrusion detection is studied. By collecting data in the field, preprocessing the data and designing the algorithm to verify the feasibility of the method. Experiments show that the proposed background intrusion detection rate based on background modeling can reach 90.56%, which greatly meets the basic requirements for intrusion detection.

articleTitle: A dynamic bayesian network approach for electro-optical system performance monitoring digital twin
publicationTitle: 2019 14th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: This paper proposes a digital twin model based on dynamic Bayesian network (DBN) for the electro-optical system for its performance monitoring. In this model, a system-level performance indicator from the perspective of the energy domain using Modulation Transfer Function (MTF) is first developed, which avoids tedious modeling of performance interactions between the multiple subsystems of the electro-optical system. Then, a DBN is constructed from the evolution of MTF to denote the dynamic performance degradation process and the propagation of epistemic uncertainty. In order to make the digital twin model capable of tracking and predicting the system performance states, an improved Gaussian particle filter with kernel smoothing (GPF-KS) is proposed as the inference algorithm for DBN. A real dataset collected in the laboratory environment is used to validate the feasibility of the digital twin model and verify the effectiveness of the GPF-KS inference algorithm. The results show that our method is effective for joint estimation of states and parameters, leading to reliable estimation and prediction of the electro-optical system on-line health-status.

articleTitle: Communication scheduling optimization for test system of FCV propulsion system
publicationTitle: 2019 14th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: In order to achieve real-time and dynamic test for propulsion system of fuel cell vehicle (FCV), a distributed test system based on components from different suppliers has been made out. However, varied component sourcing leads to a multi-network architecture, which will cause asynchronous communication and then reduce the control accuracy of the test system. So a communication scheduling optimization method based on Particle Swarm Optimization (abbreviated PSO) and Chaotic Local Search (abbreviated CLS) algorithm is introduced to solve the problem. The simulation results and actual test case demonstrate the effectiveness of the scheduling optimization method.

Author Keywords: Test system of FCV propulsion system

articleTitle: Measurement of RF AM signal based on broadband sampling oscilloscope
publicationTitle: 2019 14th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: In this paper, a new traceable method for measuring RF AM signal is presented. The 50GHz broadband sampling oscilloscope which is the national pulse parameter reference is used to measure the RF AM signal. A waveform measurement system for radio frequency amplitude modulation signal is constructed. After correcting the time-based jitter error of the collected waveform, the phase, amplitude and frequency parameters of radio frequency amplitude modulation signal are accurately restored by the co-directional orthogonal method and the least square method. The experimental results show that the method of using broadband sampling oscilloscope to measure the RF amplitude modulation signal and digitizing demodulation signal has excellent results, which achieves the accurate recovery of waveform parameters, and provides a new idea for traceability measurement of time domain RF modulation signal.

articleTitle: Frequency domain analysis of radiation sensitivity of transmission line
publicationTitle: 2019 14th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of radiation sensitivity of double conductor transmission lines, this paper carries out simulation analysis from two aspects of certainty and uncertainty. In the deterministic case, the transmission lines with different load impedance at different angles are simulated and analyzed. In the case of uncertainty, Monte Carlo method is used to simulate the radiation sensitivity of double conductor transmission lines, and the effective mean and upper limit of radiation sensitivity response current are obtained.

articleTitle: Research on leakage monitoring method of pressurizer based on fuzzy inference
publicationTitle: 2019 14th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Pressurizer leakage can cause reactor coolant loss and primary coolant pressure drop, inducing accidents. In order to solve the leakage problem of pressurizer, a leakage monitoring method based on fuzzy inference is studied. In this method, the change rate of operation parameters related to the leakage of the pressurizer is taken as the input variable of the fuzzy inference module, the Mamdani-type inference system is used for reasoning, and the fault probability operation is used to analyze the results, thus the leakage monitoring results of the pressurizer are obtained. The simulation data of the nuclear power simulator are used to verify the proposed method. The test results of normal operation, liquid phase leakage of pressurizer, vapor phase leakage of pressurizer and simultaneous leakage of liquid phase and cold end of primary circuit in typical working conditions show that the proposed method is feasible; compared with other leakage monitoring methods, this method is simple and easy to implement, thus providing an alternative scheme for leakage monitoring of pressurizers.

articleTitle: Application of atomic magnetometer based on nonlinear magneto-optical rotation in soft magnetic materials testing
publicationTitle: 2019 14th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: A new application in measuring the coercivity of a soft magnetic material (nanocrystalline alloy, lk107) by atomic magnetometer based on pump-probe nonlinear magneto-optical rotation is proposed. The magnetization states of the soft magnetic sample magnetized or demagnetized by a pulse current are successfully measured after the magnetizing current being closed. The hysteresis loops with good repeatability are obtained, and the reproducibility of the coercivity values is expressed by the relative standard deviation of 0.8 %. The method and design is good to extend the application of this NMOR atomic magnetometer. Additional applications and future improvements are also discussed.
